# Copilot Cloud Agent Instructions

## Project overview

This repository is an **Obsidian plugin** called **OriginTrail Shared Memory** (plugin ID: `origintrail-shared-memory`). It connects an Obsidian vault to a locally running [OriginTrail DKG v10](https://github.com/OriginTrail/dkg) node, importing Markdown notes as graph assertions into DKG Working Memory and optionally promoting them to Shared Memory.

- **Language**: TypeScript (strict, ES2022, no implicit any)
- **Package manager**: pnpm (always use `pnpm`, never `npm` or `yarn`)
- **Build tool**: esbuild (via `esbuild.config.mjs`)
- **Test framework**: Vitest
- **Linter**: ESLint with `typescript-eslint` + `eslint-config-prettier`
- **Formatter**: Prettier

---

## Key commands

```bash
# Install dependencies
pnpm install

# Type-check + build production bundle (outputs main.js)
pnpm build

# Build in watch mode for development
pnpm dev

# Run tests (Vitest, no browser needed)
pnpm test

# Lint source and tests
pnpm lint

# Format source and tests
pnpm format

# Check formatting without writing
pnpm format:check
```

Always run `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` after making code changes to verify nothing is broken.

## Architecture

### Plugin lifecycle (`src/main.ts`)

- `OriginTrailSharedMemoryPlugin` extends Obsidian's `Plugin`.
- On load: registers settings tab, two commands, a vault `modify` listener for auto-sync, and a layout-ready hook that shows the first-run modal.
- Settings are persisted via Obsidian's `loadData()` / `saveData()`. A `vaultId` UUID is generated on first run.
- `client()` creates a fresh `DkgClient` from current settings on each use.

### DKG client (`src/dkgClient.ts`)

- Thin wrapper around Obsidian's `requestUrl` transport (injected via constructor for testability).
- All API calls go to a configurable base URL (default `http://127.0.0.1:9200`).
- Bearer token auth is applied when `authToken` is non-empty.
- Key methods: `status`, `identity`, `listContextGraphs`, `ensureContextGraph`, `createAssertion`, `importMarkdown`, `extractionStatus`, `promoteAssertion`.
- Errors surface as `Error` with the HTTP status and first 500 chars of the response body.

### Note sync (`src/noteSync.ts`)

- `syncMarkdownFile`: reads file content, generates assertion name, calls `createAssertion` → `importMarkdown`, polls `extractionStatus` until completed/failed/skipped, optionally calls `promoteAssertion`.
- `syncAllMarkdownFiles`: iterates all vault Markdown files, skipping `.obsidian/` and `.trash/`, calls `syncMarkdownFile` sequentially with an optional progress callback.
- Auto-sync uses a debounce timer (default 1500 ms) keyed by file path.

### Identity helpers (`src/identity.ts`)

- `slugifyContextGraphId(name)`: lowercases, strips quotes/punctuation, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric chars with `-`, trims to 80 chars.
- `makeAssertionName(vaultId, filePath, content)`: SHA-256 hash of `vaultId:normalizedPath:content`, prefixed with `obsidian-note-`, suffixed with ISO timestamp (format `YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ`).
- `makeVaultId()`: `crypto.randomUUID()` with fallback.

### Types (`src/types.ts`)

- `OriginTrailSettings` interface and `DEFAULT_SETTINGS` constant.
- `RequestTransport` type alias matching Obsidian's `requestUrl` signature — used for DI in tests.
- `ContextGraphSummary` and `SyncResult` data shapes.

---

## Settings

| Setting | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dkgNodeUrl` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:9200` | DKG node API base URL |
| `authToken` | string | `""` | Bearer token (stored only in vault's plugin data.json) |
| `defaultContextGraphId` | string | `""` | Linked DKG Project / context graph ID |
| `autoSync` | boolean | `true` | Auto-import notes on save |
| `autoPromote` | boolean | `false` | Promote to Shared Memory after import |
| `syncDebounceMs` | number | `1500` | Debounce delay in ms (min 250) |
| `vaultId` | string | UUID | Stable vault identifier for assertion naming |
| `hasSeenPowerUpPrompt` | boolean | `false` | Suppresses first-run modal after dismissal |

---

## DKG API endpoints used

```
GET  /api/status
GET  /api/agent/identity
GET  /api/context-graph/list
POST /api/context-graph/create
POST /api/assertion/create
POST /api/assertion/{name}/import-file   (multipart/form-data)
GET  /api/assertion/{name}/extraction-status?contextGraphId=...
POST /api/assertion/{name}/promote       (optional, when autoPromote=true)
```

---

## Build output

The build emits three files that are committed to the repository root and installed directly into an Obsidian vault:

- `main.js` — bundled plugin (CJS, ES2022, minified in production)
- `manifest.json` — Obsidian plugin manifest (not generated, edited directly)
- `styles.css` — plugin styles (not generated, edited directly)

The `obsidian` package is listed as an external in esbuild so it is never bundled.

---

## Testing approach

- Unit tests live in `tests/` and use Vitest.
- Only pure logic (currently `src/identity.ts`) is unit tested.
- Obsidian API calls are not unit tested; manual testing in a real vault is needed.
- The `RequestTransport` type exists for future DI-based tests of `DkgClient`.
- Run `pnpm test` to execute all tests; no browser or Obsidian instance is required.

---

## Code style and conventions

- TypeScript strict mode with `noImplicitAny` and `strictNullChecks`.
- Prefer `async/await` over `.then()` chains.
- `any` is allowed but triggers a lint warning — add a comment if unavoidable.
- Prettier handles formatting (single-line threshold, etc.) — run `pnpm format` before committing.
- Do not add comments unless they explain non-obvious logic; the codebase is intentionally comment-light.
- Avoid adding new dependencies unless strictly necessary.
- The Obsidian API (`requestUrl`, `Notice`, `Modal`, `Setting`, etc.) must always be imported from `"obsidian"` — never bundled.

---

## PR and issue conventions

- PR title should be short and descriptive.
- Fill in the PR template: summary, type of change, changed files, testing checklist.
- Testing checklist requires `pnpm test` passing, `pnpm build` succeeding, and manual Obsidian verification for UI changes.
- Issues use templates in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`.

---

## Known limitations and notes for agents

- The plugin is an MVP (v0.1.0). There is no GitHub Releases ZIP yet; users install manually.
- DKG v10 is release-candidate software on testnet — expect API iteration.
- `main.js` is committed to the repo (Obsidian plugin convention). Always regenerate it with `pnpm build` after source changes.
- Verified Memory / on-chain publishing is explicitly out of scope.
- The auth token is stored only in the local vault's plugin `data.json` — never commit tokens.
- File paths inside the vault use `/` separators on all platforms; `normalizeVaultPath` handles Windows `\` paths.
- `slugifyContextGraphId` truncates context graph IDs to 80 characters.
- The extraction polling loop retries up to 20 times with 750 ms delays (~15 s timeout).
